intro: Fill in your details and continue to payment to complete your registration.
book_delivery: We will give you the book at the first session.
payment_hint: Payment is made on Stripe. Registration is only confirmed once the payment has been verified.
success_message: We have verified the test payment. The test registration is confirmed; it does not correspond to a real place.
pending_message: We are still checking the payment. There is no need to pay again. You can check the status again in a few moments.
cancelled_message: You cancelled the payment process. Your registration is not confirmed. You can start again whenever you like.
